original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: Three broad feet brace a squat furnace beneath a broken heat halo, offset pipes, a hanging coal bowl, and a hammer-capped vent.
A low crescent of wet timbers hides a narrow gate inside one huge hooked snare, three reed fins, and two unequal bone floats.
Three open singing arches rise from a broad stepped base beneath an uneven prism roof, two bells, and one tall tuning fork.
Two tall mirrored arches overlap without touching above a zigzag walkway, floating diamond lens, three needles, and a broken stair.
Seven uneven stones spiral upward in living moss beneath a forked root crown, with three shallow bowls and one hanging seedglass drop.
A low open kennel of thorn branches carries two mismatched antlers, one hooked whistle, and three paw-shaped trail plaques.
Three braided living roots form a compact bridge between unequal bark piers, leaf braces, a woven deck, and one hanging seed weight.
A crooked tripod orrery carries three mismatched orbit rings, an eight-point false star, crescent dial, two bells, and a long hook.
A squat pressure gantry carries one oversized bell, three unequal square hammers, a broken base cog, and a narrow vent, readable by its broad stepped silhouette.
A tilted broad crucible rises beside one spiral condenser, three unequal measuring scoops, and a crooked slag channel, forming a tall hooked silhouette.
Three nested cooling coils wrap a blank upright ledger plate between offset radiator fins, a long drip valve, and one hanging quench bowl.
A low crescent toll arch bears two side drums, three hanging tally cages, a forked reed crown, and a heavy hooked counterweight.
A forked living root lifts three differently shaped seed lenses above one hanging pendulum and a carved grafting stone, with an open budding crown.
A tall cracked oval mirror with one missing wedge stands between two unequal bone uprights above a shallow bowl and three visibly snapped cords.
A curved ship rib leans into one three-pronged harpoon above three unequal hanging rings, a heavy rope coil, and a small plumb weight.
A leaning shell lectern carries one enormous hooked quill above three blank hanging tablets, a faceted inkwell, and one offset cracked bell.
An asymmetrical charred-bronze reading stand carries a hinged amber beacon, three blank wax tablets, blue cord, and a forked route-pointer finial.
A crooked reed cage under a mushroom hood holds a peat brazier, three empty bark masks on bone hooks, moss, and a muted violet glow.
A narrow crystalline seat stands on unequal glass feet beneath three angled mirror vanes, an open solar ring, and a cobalt calibration ribbon.
A living forked-root chair curls around a carved grafting stone with three bark seed bowls, a woven russet sash, moss, and a budding arch.
A squat black-iron examiner chair sits inside an asymmetric pressure frame with three unequal counterweight levers, a chain pedal, and red-black pennant.
A leaning memorial mast bears three distinct shell bells above three sea-glass memory bowls, a hooked crossbar, dark ribbons, and a crescent mourning sail.
A squat floodgate plinth carries three separate copper warrant canisters beneath a forked beacon cage and two broad locking bars.
A crescent bogwood muster drum bears three dangling bone-and-bronze hook tokens beside a crooked levy post and marsh lantern.
A white-stone solar plinth presents three unequal crystal warrant prisms within a broad golden measuring yoke and split sun vane.
A living root arch suspends three distinct seed-pod warrant capsules below an antler-like tally branch and blank bark tablet.
A riveted foundry pedestal mounts three pressure-gauge warrant cylinders before a toothed half-wheel, piston, and blank assay plate.
A salt-dark ship-rib callboard holds three separate funeral bells and pale glass warrants above a crescent anchor hook and slate plaque.
A compact charred-bronze campaign table stands between two unequal forked blue beacon standards, with an amber signal cage, wax route tablets, and a floodgate-stone base.
A crooked reed-and-bone command dais bears two distinct ragged hide standards above a peat brazier, chained route tokens, tusk hooks, and a low mudstone footing.
A faceted crystal planning plinth glows beneath two asymmetrical blue-and-ivory mirror pennants, a small solar ring, prism route markers, and stepped white stone.
A living forked-root strategy seat supports two unequal woven leaf standards, two seed route bowls, a carved grafting stone, moss, and a compact root base.
A squat black-iron dispatch rig carries two offset riveted red standards above a pressure-gauge planning plate, chain route weights, and a furnace-brick base.
A leaning tideglass chart mast flies two distinct mourning pennants above shell signal bells, salt route stones, dark driftwood, and a sea-glass base.
A low crescent toll hook carries a hide tally ring and three uneven marsh-reed weights, making the captured Mireclaw claim readable by its hooked silhouette.
A tall split-prism rapier is crossed by one off-center orbit ring, giving Renn's exact duel line a narrow asymmetric silhouette without relying on color.
A broad living-root barrow arches over three unequal medicine jars and a low stone cairn, identifying Merek's recovery line by mass and hanging shapes.
An oversized black foundry bell hangs from an asymmetric pressure frame beside one chained square hammer, making Oren's siege gauge unmistakable in silhouette.
A curved ship rib supports a long barbed harpoon vane and one hanging tideglass, giving Ruln's wake pennant a forward-leaning coastal silhouette.
A forked river pike carries three separate rain-charred charter plates above a small beacon bowl, identifying Torren's line by its open double-prong crown.
